authority: docs/OWNER_SPEC.md OWNER v2.0 EUR300 and 2026-11-08 universe expansion
purpose: One outcome-blind, cost-first, coordinated, four-class economic test on SIX Pepperstone instruments outside the original twelve M5, reusing only genuine authenticated H1 and quote-source wire evidence; none of the frozen MBF1/ERP1 strategy functions or economic outcomes is called.

source.sourceReadback: original ciphertext and original runId+protocol hash; revalidate original exact account double SHA, EUR Pepperstone trader, all request-response protobuf identity, contract min volume, margin and H1/quote geometry
source.finalProduct: cTrader Algo Bars H1, Bars TickVolumes, Symbol/Pending/History, pure C# Linux Cloud; no external runtime

costModel.note: Genuine original BID/ASK spreads with source-as-of freshness<=2s and skew<=2s; tiered conservative assumed commissions, currency conversions and slippage from original MBF1/ERP1 policies. Historical fill, tariff, financing, net broker EUR unknown.
costModel.central: 1.5 * original valid development spread median bps + 2*(2bps commission + 1bps currency conversion)
costModel.adverse: 2 * original valid development spread empirical p90 bps + 2*(4bps commission + 2bps currency conversion)
costModel.stress: 3 * original max valid development spread bps + 2*(8bps commission + 4bps currency conversion)

h1Decision.at: after H1 t completed; need 25 consecutive H1 bars including current and 24 prior
h1Decision.entry: next completed H1 close (t+60m) as source proxy, never executable fill
h1Decision.benchmark: matched same-symbol prior H1 one-hour sign at same decision, same holding, same adverse cost if nonflat; cash flat with zero trades
h1Decision.grossBasis: complete-source-price-close ratio in bps, never funded NET EUR

families.economicMechanism: Oil supply/inventory information can take several hours to be digested; a genuine H1 volume-confirmed four-hour impulse may persist across energy CFD price discoveries, without hedging or replaying the closed ERP1 pair spread.
families.signal: Last completed 4h log return absolute >=max(15bps, 3x prior completed 24h median absolute one-hour return), current H1 tick volume>=1.10x prior20 median hour volume, then follow sign of 4h return for 4h.

families.economicMechanism: After an unusually large 24h crypto liquidation (at least 180bps), the first contrary H1 close of at least 10bps may mark a rebound toward liquidity; trades counter the original 24h shock, not the closed MBF1 weekend shock-drift.
families.signal: Abs(24h log return)>=180bps and current H1 log return opposite to 24h sign with abs >=10bps; predict direction of current H1 rebound for six H1 closes.

families.economicMechanism: Joint synchronous regional index repricing after already completed four-hour returns may persist through the next three trading hours; this is neither MBF1 Tokyo-to-HK underreaction nor closed index-to-FX transmission.
families.signal: Both HK50 and JPN225-F have 4h completed H1 return absolute>=20bps, signs agree; individual current H1 tick volume>=prior12 observed median; follow the common 4h sign for three complete hours.

families.economicMechanism: A one-hour high-volume stop-rejection candlestick without any lookahead pivot can mark exhaustion of GBPJPY intraday leveraged flow; test two-hour fade, distinct from closed Tokyo 4h inventory unwind.
families.signal: H1 upper wick >=60% candle range and close<open => SHORT, or lower wick >=60% range and close>open => LONG, only when current tick volume>=median prior12 H1 tick volumes; no 12h Donchian breach or future swing pivot.

uncertainty.developmentF2: existing prospective_economic_futility, 26 independent-calendar-week *clusters* with true empty weeks, HAC3, Bonferroni eight prespecified 1s comparisons
uncertainty.selection: HAC3 Bonferroni corrected one-sided weekly adverse NET and matched benchmark incremental lower bounds both>0 on next 13 exposed selection weeks
